Container.Name: label-printer
Container.Overview:
Label printer for Zebra GK420 / ZPL printers. Upload or paste an image (screenshot of a shipping label, barcode), crop it, convert it to 1-bit at the printer's 203 dpi and print it as raw ZPL through CUPS, with no driver resampling or dithering. Also has a text label composer.
This is the LAN instance: never port-forward it or put it behind a reverse proxy. Set PRINT_ALLOW_CIDRS to your LAN subnet only.
Container.Requires: A CUPS server on the LAN with a queue for the Zebra, and cupsd listening on the network (Listen 0.0.0.0:631).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: CUPS host
Config.Description: CUPS server address, optionally host:port (e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.50:631). Empty disables direct printing.

Config.Name: CUPS printer queue
Config.Description: Queue name exactly as 'lpstat -p' shows it on the CUPS server.

Config.Name: Allowed client networks
Config.Description: Comma-separated CIDRs allowed to print, matched against the real client address. Your LAN subnet only. Do NOT include 172.16.0.0/12 (Docker bridge).

Config.Name: Print token
Config.Description: Optional shared secret required in addition to the network check. Leave empty for none.

Config.Name: Printer dpi
Config.Description: 203 for GK420d/t and ZD410; 300 for 300 dpi models.

Config.Name: lp options for image labels (ZPL)
Config.Description: Passed to lp for image labels. -o raw sends the ZPL to the printer untouched.

Config.Name: lp options for text labels (PNG)
Config.Description: Passed to lp for text labels, which are sent as PNG through the CUPS driver.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Leave EMPTY unless this container sits behind a reverse proxy. Addresses listed here may declare the client address via X-Forwarded-For.

Config.Name: Rate limit
Config.Description: Print jobs per minute across all clients.

Config.Name: lp timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for lp to reach CUPS.
